title: Auto Crafter
subtitle: Any crafting recipe, on power
text:
Click items into the 3x3 pattern; nothing is used up. Right click a slot with an empty hand to clear it, or press x to clear the lot. JEI's + button fills the pattern too.

The Ingredients row holds one stack per ingredient; tools and other unstackables get one slot each. Pipes and hoppers can only put matching items in.

Results and leftovers such as empty buckets or used tools land in the 4 outputs. It waits when they are full. 20 FE/t for 5 seconds a craft, faster on steel. The redstone button picks always on, run with a signal or stop with one.
caption: Any side can take FE, items or an output port
